interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crossings to improve pedestrian visibility and safety.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at intersections to shorten crossing distances and slow traffic.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lanes
interventions.description: Replace sharrows with physically separated lanes to protect cyclists and narrow the roadway.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian warning signage
interventions.description: Install pedestrian crossing signs, potentially with Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFBs), to alert drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island

interventions.description: Relocate the utility pole or widen the sidewalk to ensure a minimum 4-foot clear walking path is maintained around obstructions.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Install a furniture or planting zone between the curb and the sidewalk to provide physical separation from moving traffic.

interventions.description: Resurface the roadway and repair the sidewalk to eliminate trip hazards and improve drainage.
